title: 第397章 番外：权臣在现代（三）
slug: 读心后疯批暴君决定洗白
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“所以你念了这一大串，到底是想吃哪个？”

面对祝卿安疑惑的神色，宋雲初原本想回一句“都吃”，可转念一想，这么回答似乎不太行。

她怎么又忘了，饮食也得入乡随俗，不能把前世奢靡的习惯带来，现代人吃顿饭，正常情况下不会点一大桌来自不同品牌的食物，她报上来的那些，得跑很多店。

哪怕是点外送，都得下十几单。

也太麻烦了。

于是她回答道：“上边这些都行，哪个近就去哪个。”

“那就去前边那个广场，有你想吃的披萨和意面，过一个红绿灯就到。”

“好。”

事实证明，原主记忆中的那些美食果然不令人失望。

现代人做菜的智慧，不得不服。

吃饱回家的路上，三人途经一家奶茶店，林夕买了三杯杨枝甘露。

宋雲初喝了一口，目光微闪。

奶茶果然好喝。

由于刚醒来时那辆出租车的味道令她印象深刻，回去的路上她实在不愿打车，三人便改坐公交。

宋雲初将窗户开了小半边，感受着车窗外的习习凉风。

这现代的交通工具真有意思。

回到了住的地方后，已经过了凌晨十二点。

“安安，都这么晚了，你还要回去吗？你上午应该不直播吧？”

“对，明天下午才上班，我晚上跟阿初睡，我先去洗澡了。”

宋雲初听着身后二人的对话，不语。

和旁人一起睡吗……从未经历过。

毕竟前世的她没有好朋友，即便有几个忠心不二的下属，也不会与她太亲近。

祝卿安洗了澡后，就在宋雲初的床上躺下了。

宋雲初望着另外半边床，犹豫片刻，终究还是坐了下来，靠着床头又翻出了手机。

"So after reading this list, which one do you want to eat?"

Faced with Zhu Qing'an's confused look, Song Yunchu originally wanted to reply, "Eat them all," but then he thought about it, and that answer didn't seem to work.

How could she have forgotten that food should be adapted to the local customs, and the extravagant habits of the previous life should not be brought over. Modern people would not normally order a large table of food from different brands when eating a meal. The ones she reported had to go to many stores.

Even if you order delivery, you have to place more than a dozen orders.

It’s too much trouble.

So she replied: "All of the above are fine, just go to whichever one is closest."

"Then go to the square in front. There's pizza and pasta you want to eat. Just cross the traffic light and you'll be there."

"Okay."

It turns out that the delicious food in the memory of the original owner did not disappoint.

I have to be convinced by the wisdom of modern people in cooking.

On the way home after eating, the three of them passed by a milk tea shop, and Lin Xi bought three cups of poplar nectar.

Song Yunchu took a sip and his eyes flashed slightly.

The milk tea is really delicious.

Since the smell of the taxi when she woke up impressed her so much, she really didn't want to take a taxi on the way back, so the three of them took the bus instead.

Song Yunchu opened the window half way and felt the cool breeze outside the car window.

This modern means of transportation is really interesting.

After returning to the place where I lived, it was already past twelve o'clock in the morning.

"An'an, it's already so late, do you still want to go back? You shouldn't be broadcasting live this morning, right?"

"Yes, I won't go to work until tomorrow afternoon. I'll sleep with Ah Chu tonight, and I'll take a shower first."

Song Yunchu was silent as he listened to the conversation between the two people behind him.

Sleeping with others... I have never experienced this.

After all, she had no good friends in her previous life, and even if she had a few loyal subordinates, they would not get too close to her.

After Zhu Qingan took a shower, she lay down on Song Yunchu's bed.

Song Yunchu looked at the other half of the bed, hesitated for a moment, and finally sat down, leaning against the bedside and pulling out his cell phone.
